column1: # Book 5 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). No findings. 5.882 taken verbatim from the Book 4 review text (4.53, same Latin). 5.910 simili ratione = by a like principle (register). 5.884, 5.905, 5.907, 5.969 brought into the band.

column2: which one may come to know from this, however dull one's heart.
flowers in vigor, the boy not at all; for often even then
lion in front, snake behind, herself the middle, the Chimaera {{NOTE: "herself": chimaera is also the Greek for a she-goat, so the middle is goat; the pun is lost in English}}
Therefore whoever imagines that, the earth new and the sky
may babble out many things by a like principle:
many they overcame, a few they shunned in hiding places;
